paper.title: Comparing Classical and Quantum Variational Classifiers on the XOR Problem
paper.public_claim_scope_observed: two-qubit VQC with depths 1 and 2 on XOR variants; depth 2 can match representative XOR accuracy, while the MLP is reported substantially faster and no clear efficiency advantage is reported

architecture.encoding: RX(pi*x[0]) on wire 0; RX(pi*x[1]) on wire 1
architecture.ansatz_per_layer: Rot(3 params) on wire 0; Rot(3 params) on wire 1; CNOT(0->1)

training.optimizer: full-batch gradient descent in reported simulator settings

public_code.hardware_note: public repository states that IBM hardware executions described in the manuscript are not included in the public artifact

uqpu_reproduction_scope.dataset_change: Batch039 deterministic continuous quadrant-XOR/XNOR contract is retained; inputs are affinely mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1] before public RX encoding
uqpu_reproduction_scope.label_change: Batch039 labels same-sign quadrants as class 1, complementing the paper Dataset-C XOR convention; UQPU therefore applies a fixed output-label complement
uqpu_reproduction_scope.simulator: independent pure-Python ideal two-qubit statevector implementation with exact forward analytic derivatives

research_attribution.ai_assisted_contribution: public literature/code provenance audit and reproduction-interface mapping
